conclusion_zh: M2工作噪声模型在同一短窗中改善了U1航向和位置，速度没有改善；原V3在该共同区间的航向、水平位置和3D位置仍更好。首个有限工作域支持21维物理整数候选进入共同图，但最终支持不完全，不能称正式AR、持续可信航向或稳定导航收益。

velocity_same_frozen_bridge.approximate_geometry: User approximate height 0.325 m; POI-to-IMU [0,0,-0.325] in POI/VRTK; horizontal/angle uncertainty unbounded, not exact extrinsic
velocity_same_frozen_bridge.conclusion: Both horizontal and3D velocity RMSE increase slightly versus oldU1; heading-to-velocity benefit is not demonstrated. Approximate POI-to-IMU geometry and shared GNSS reference lineage prevent an independent exact-point claim.

first_integer_conditioned_working_domain.interpretation: Exactly one integer candidate was found in the completely enumerated finite Gaussian raw working domain and has a rigid-length feasible witness. Conditioning the common graph on that candidate is not a false-fix guarantee or a physical-domain coverage certificate.

whole_short_run_support.later_incompleteness: Finite raw enumerations reach the20000-node budget; surviving candidates remain conditional and omitted possibilities are not declared scientifically excluded. Later complete local windows do not erase earlier omitted support.

foot_common_state_and_research_progress.actual_participation: U1 consumes actual foot/contact factors in the shared navigation state together with IMU and raw code/carrier; beta is an explicit physical SD source process in that graph, with the identical temporal covariance used by raw candidate proposals.
foot_common_state_and_research_progress.foot_increment: This M2 run has no paired M2-U0 ablation. The older native05 U1-vs-U0 short-window evidence showed only0.162921deg yaw,0.001479m H and0.002387m3D RMSE reductions; those old increments cannot be attributed to the new M2 result.
foot_common_state_and_research_progress.heading_mediation: Lower yaw and position errors coexist in the shared-state output, but this version comparison does not isolate heading as the mediator. Velocity is slightly worse; the heading-to-velocity/position causal chain remains unproved.
foot_common_state_and_research_progress.failure_revocation: This is U1: no support-model revocation or historical replay occurs in this run. It does not validate contact-aid invalidation/retraction.
foot_common_state_and_research_progress.innovation_1: Progress: physical short-baseline integer coordinates and full correlated likelihood now produce a real rigid-length-feasible conditional candidate. Open: calibrated use eligibility, tilt/support robustness and false-fix/direction coverage.
foot_common_state_and_research_progress.innovation_2: Progress: feet participate in common-state estimation. Open: new-model foot increment, information acceptance under impact/support changes, and valid dependency revocation evidence.
foot_common_state_and_research_progress.innovation_3: Progress: physical arc relations and source-noise identity survive pivot/arc changes in the same graph. Open: sustained partial carrier/support information retention, outages and reliable navigation recovery.

fairness_and_limits.old_native05_comparison: Same requested start and common finite measurement interval, native IMU input configuration and U1 role; source versions differ, so this is a same-backend research-version comparison, not an isolated single-factor M2 or foot ablation.
fairness_and_limits.frozen_V3_startup_difference: joint starts at requested run start; frozen V3 is the original 66--340 s causal run, not restarted at this short window
fairness_and_limits.reference: Fixposition-derived fused reference with shared GNSS lineage; not independent truth
fairness_and_limits.timing_scope: state accuracy at measurement epochs; not a zero-delay arrival-time navigation comparison
fairness_and_limits.finite_only_policy: NO_INIT rows remain unavailable, not zero error; every reported position/heading comparison uses the same5.802s physical interval.
fairness_and_limits.no_stable_gain_claim: A5.802s finite development interval with incomplete final support does not establish performance over turning, support changes and carrier interruption.

frozen_model_and_next_decision.decision: Keep the frozen BY M2 scales/tau and original raw-domain quantile. Do not tune parameters against this short-window accuracy readout.
frozen_model_and_next_decision.next_run: FULL09 M2 versus FULL07 original-Q U1 on the same66--340s measurement interval and start; retain complete requested-window coverage/NO_INIT, compare common finite yaw/p/v, source-support status and outage/recovery behavior.
frozen_model_and_next_decision.development_overlap_boundary: The66--340s BY development interval includes the110--170s noise-calibration and180--240s validation blocks; it is a full navigation-development comparison, not an independent unseen-sequence generalization claim.
